fusions.name: Burning Glass
fusions.desc: Focuses sunlight through a lens onto an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 4 damage and leaves it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Banked Noon
fusions.desc: Releases the heat a solar battery has stored across a cone 4 tiles long, which deals 26 damage to everything in it, ignoring their resistances.

fusions.name: Regrowth Pump
fusions.desc: Starts a regrowth pump that restores 3 health a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Solar Collector
fusions.desc: During the day, you deal 10% more damage.
